args: pin=$1; shift; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --from "$pin" evo-agents --version </dev/null >/dev/null && exec uvx --offline --from "$pin" evo-agents "$@"; command -v evo-agents >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$0: $* did not start: uvx could not run $pin and evo-agents is not on the PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "$0: uvx could not run $pin, so evo-agents from PATH runs $*" >&2; exec evo-agents "$@"
